about: Charles Scott, Jr. is an attorney who represents clients in the San Diego, California area. Charles Scott, Jr. is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2008 - 2009. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Charles Scott, Jr. chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of California Berkeley School of Law and graduated in 1977. Charles Scott, Jr. passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1977.
He represents clients with Estate Planning & Probate issues in California. He also represents clients with Estate & Trust Litigation and Elder Law issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Charles Scott, Jr. has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
